independence_evidence: The about page states 'Brownstone Cowboys is an independent media house and production studio based between London and New York'; it is self-published and not part of any media group.
qualifies_reason: Self-described independent publisher whose first print 'book' appeared in April 2026 and whose second (320 pages, 12 covers) is on sale as of October 2026.
what_it_is: Brownstone Cowboys is a fashion-and-culture journal built on long interviews and image-led editorials with people in fashion, art, music and film; the second print volume runs to 320 sewn-bound pages and comes with twelve different covers, from Willy Chavarria to Carrie Coon and Meadow Walker. It began online and moved into print in 2026, publishing a 'book' roughly twice a year alongside the website. It suits readers of large-format fashion culture titles who want extended conversations rather than short features.
